facts.name: traqfreq
facts.tagline: jimbo-dj's successor, built beside it: listening history, library, servers, tags and playlists, every number showing its rows

integrations.name: jimbo-dj
integrations.what: its database: library, listening history, stored stats

integrations.name: Plex
integrations.what: the library and Plex plays through jimbo-dj's sync; from T30 traqfreq's own sync and watcher (GET only), live from cut-over 1

integrations.name: jimbodj-text
integrations.what: the Ask box (T28): jimbo-dj's CLAP text server turns words into a vector

integrations.name: Ollama
integrations.what: the Ask box (T28), optional and off by default: words read into the library's styles, moods and decades

now: P6 cut-overs (T29–T30 done, 2026-11-27): traqfreq's own library.sqlite with the one-time copy, its count check, the reading connection and rollback; the Plex sync and watcher (jimbo-dj's, vendored, writing only once plex is owned), the runs log and the switch-off check on SETUP
P5 PLAYLISTS passed its gate on live data (2026-11-26); traqfreq shows everything jimbo-dj shows, read-only
